newsitem.title: UK: Misys shoots up on DKB recommendation.
newsitem.headline: Misys shoots up on DKB recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Misys Plc, the British software supplier, surged ahead on Friday after analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson reiterated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, traders said.
"Kleinwort have issued a large note in the IT software area which is boosting the stock and we're saying buy Misys," one market-maker said.
The stock was up 37-1/2p at 12.17-1/2 stg by 1030 GMT. Misys shares were off recent highs seen in mid-March, but traders said they had been looking strong over the last few days.

"We've been buyers of Misys over the last 12 months anyway, but what we've done today is reiterate that "buy" recommendation putting it in the context of international valuation," said Derek Brown, IT analyst at DKB.

Brown said DKB had put out an IT/software review on Friday looking at all stocks in the sector in Britain and comparing them with international competitors. Misys came out as a favourite in the sector. --Tara FitzGerald, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4365
